answer: Since the throttle counters live in the plume ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 220 keys therefore pays for 220 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the oasis quota and the forge admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 2 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
